summary: Greatship (India) Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of Great Eastern Shipping, received 8 review notices under the MVAT Act for FY14-FY17 regarding charter hire tax treatment.

headline: ABM Knowledgeware discloses gift transfer of 31,000 shares
summary: ABM Knowledgeware Ltd reported an off-market transfer of 31,000 equity shares by way of gift from Designated Person Pushpa Singh to her immediate relative.

headline: United Cotfab secretarial auditor resigns
summary: United Cotfab Limited announced the resignation of M/s. M. K. Samdani & Co. as Secretarial Auditor effective September 29, 2026, citing professional commitments.

headline: Small appliance makers hold prices amid festive season
summary: Small appliance manufacturers are keeping prices steady even as major brands raise prices ahead of the festive season, with large appliance makers set to increase prices from October.
